v2a_falsifiable_guards: Immediately before any leaf extraction, require exact source config SHA and one expected root-owned mihomo PID with exact -d, -f and -ext-ctl-unix argv, plus root-owned Unix socket at the exact path.
On every Unix connection use LOCAL_PEERPID and reject unless it equals that still-live PID; do not use socket pathname/owner alone as process identity.

Read only current selection through GET, cap response bytes, reject non-200/malformed/unknown/cyclic/DIRECT or REJECT leaf; never emit the leaf name, full proxy object, secret or raw response into versioned evidence.
Recheck source SHA, sole PID/UID/argv and socket peer PID after reading; selection is time-varying, so re-read immediately before constructing a private config and abort if leaf changed.

Treat no-auth GET 200 as a confidentiality/access-control boundary: the socket directory root:staff mode 2770 permits staff access while socket mode 0777. Bearer header is not demonstrated as an enforcement gate.
Do not infer running binary bytes from ps path alone; bind binary provenance separately if required. Do not query remote gz02 or mutate global state in v2a.
limits: One observed current leaf at one time; no availability or future selection guarantee.
Local peer PID and process arguments strongly bind this Unix endpoint to the running process but do not cryptographically attest its executable image.
No private config generated, process started, SSH or gz02 network performed.
